metadata.case_name: YAU PO SHAN v. THE EXPRESS LIFT CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: Form 5 graduate; enrolled in secretarial course

source: Both the 2 Experts agreed in Joint Report, and I find, that Ms Yau suffered from soft tissues injuries at her neck, low back and right ankle as a result of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level, unspecified

injuries.description: soft tissue injury at low back
source: Both the 2 Experts agreed in Joint Report, and I find, that Ms Yau suffered from soft tissues injuries at her neck, low back and right ankle as a result of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: soft tissue injury at right ankle
source: Both the 2 Experts agreed in Joint Report, and I find, that Ms Yau suffered from soft tissues injuries at her neck, low back and right ankle as a result of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of ankle, unspecified

manifestations.description: Neck pain and tenderness; mild residual pain, numbness and/or stiffness over neck
Low back pain and tenderness; mild residual pain, numbness and/or stiffness over spine
Impaired lifting capacity to perform strenuous activities such as lifting weight
Avoidance of carrying her first newborn baby due to injuries

treatments_received.treatment: Emergency Department treatment (A&E) at Tuen Mun Hospital
source: On arrival at A&E Dept of TMH, Ms Yau complained of neck, low back and right ankle injury. Examination revealed tenderness over neck, low back and right ankle regions. Cervical spines X-ray showed no fracture. She was treated and discharged on the same day.

treatments_received.treatment: Consultation with Dr Tio Man Kwun Peter
source: On 5 Nov 2011, Ms Yau consulted Dr Tio Man Kwun Peter (Dr Tio).

treatments_received.treatment: Hong Kong Sport and Dance Injury Centre treatment (5 occasions)
source: She thereafter attended Hong Kong Sport and Dance Injury Centre on 5 occasions for treatment between 8 and 16 Nov 2011.

treatments_received.treatment: Consultation with Dr T. K. Tan
source: On 22 Nov 2011, she consulted Dr T. K. Tan (Dr Tan).
Afterwards, she received chiropractic treatment from a chiropractic doctor on 32 occasions from 22 Nov 2011 to 23 Apr 2012.

treatments_received.treatment: Consultation with Dr Julian W. Chang
source: On 20 Mar 2012, she consulted Dr Chang.

losses.category: Loss of ability to participate in parenthood or grandparenthood
losses.description: had to avoid carrying her first newborn baby (born in 2013) due to her injuries in the Accident

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: temporarily unable to return to sports prior to end of April 2012 due to soft tissue injuries

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Impaired lifting capacity to perform strenuous activities such as lifting weight due to residual neck and back pain
